name: Bishlam
overview: The Scripture passages in Ezra 4 reveal Bishlam as a Samaritan who actively opposed the rebuilding of the temple in Jerusalem. Along with other leaders and their associates, Bishlam wrote letters to King Artaxerxes, accusing the returning Jews of rebellion and undermining the restoration efforts. This opposition highlights the spiritual and political challenges faced by God's people as they sought to rebuild the temple and reestablish worship in Jerusalem.
